blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it

findings.recommendation: The migration paths were verified once by hand on staging (tasks 1.1 and 1.2). Add unit tests that load a TOML file using `listen` and one using `bind_address` through `config::load`, and that serialize an `OrderResponse` and assert the JSON key is `customer_id` (src/api.rs:10-11), so that dropping the alias or the rename in a later change fails the build instead of breaking existing config files or partners' integrations.
findings.title: The `listen` alias and the `customer_id` JSON key have no automated test

findings.recommendation: The release note invites operators to rename `listen` to `bind_address`, but the previous release's `Config` requires `listen`, so a 4.1 instance started on a migrated file (rollback, or old and new instances sharing one file during a rolling deploy) fails at start-up with a missing-field error. Whether that happens depends on deployment practice the reviewer could not see. Add to the release note that files should keep `listen` until rollback to 4.1 is no longer needed, or that a rollback requires restoring `listen`.
findings.title: Rolling back to 4.1 fails on a config file already moved to `bind_address`
